About the Scholarship

MERGED trains membrane engineers for water treatment, gas separation and sustainable industrial processes across a French-coordinated consortium. Each year's call, with its scholarship deadline and mobility options, is published on the programme's application-procedure page.

OpportunityMERGED – Erasmus Mundus Master in Membrane Engineering for Sustainable Development
HostMERGED Consortium
LocationMontpellier (multi-country mobility), France
Study LevelMaster's
FundingFully Funded
StipendErasmus Mundus scholarships for selected students:
Application DeadlineAnnual call — the current closing date is published on the application-procedure page
ApplyOfficial application page ↗

MERGED trains membrane engineers for water treatment, gas separation and sustainable industrial processes across a French-coordinated consortium. Each year's call, with its scholarship deadline and mobility options, is published on the programme's application-procedure page.

Programme Highlights

  • Specialised membrane-engineering curriculum with lab and pilot-scale training
  • Application to water, energy and process industries
  • Scholarship round announced annually on the official page
  • Graduates enter water utilities, process industries and membrane R&D

Who Should Apply

Chemical engineering, chemistry and environmental engineering graduates are the core audience, with strong transport-phenomena basics expected.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus scholarships for selected students: participation costs plus monthly allowance.

Deadline and How to Apply

Check the MERGED application-procedure page for the live call and submit the requested documents through the consortium's form. Key deadline information: Annual call — the current closing date is published on the application-procedure page.

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About MERGED Consortium

The MERGED consortium delivers the Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Membrane Engineering for Sustainable Development with French coordination and European membrane-research partners.

Official website: https://merged.info

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: Annual call - see official page - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

Application guides

  • University Motivation Letter: Explain Your Preparation and Course Choice
  • A 12-Month Study Abroad Application Plan for Master's and PhD Applicants
